newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-TROUBLED ALANIA'S COACH ASKED TO STAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TROUBLED ALANIA'S COACH ASKED TO STAY.

text.p: Coach Valery Gazzayev of Alania Vladikavkaz, runners-up in the Russian soccer league last season, has been persuaded to stay in his position after tendering his resignation.
Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday that Gazzayev would remain in his post after President Akhsarbek Galazov of the North Ossetia region where the team is based asked him to stay.

Gazzayev submitted his resignation after the side began the current season by losing three successive league and cup ties at home and winning only two of their first seven matches. They are in 13th position.
Galazov said the team, hugely popular in the tiny north Caucasus region, still had the full support of the republic despite what he called "a run of bad luck".
Gazzayev had pledged to do his best to get the club back to the top.
